item.title: NS trains to run reduced schedule Wednesday; “Significant disruption” due to snowfall
item.description: Trains in the Netherlands will again operate on a reduced, winter weather timetable on Wednesday due to predictions of snowfall over the course of the day.

item.title: Wednesday snow warning intensified to Code Orange for most of the Netherlands
item.description: A Code Orange weather warning was issued for most of the Netherlands on Wednesday morning, with heavy snow expected, and persistent, icy roads. The warning will go into effect from 6 a.m.

item.title: Erik Ten Hag returns to FC Twente as Technical Director
item.description: Football coach Erik ten Hag will make his return to FC Twente on Feb. 1 after signing a deal to become the Enschede club’s new technical director.

item.title: KLM warns of scammers targeting passengers with fake compensation messages
item.description: KLM is alerting passengers to fraudsters claiming to be customer service representatives.

item.title: Record number of fireworks injuries during New Year’s, Dutch safety institute reports
item.description: During this year’s New Year’s celebrations, emergency departments saw the largest number of fireworks-related injuries in years.

item.title: Snow and ice slow down grocery deliveries, but shelves mostly stocked
item.description: Winter weather may cause minor delays in supermarket deliveries in parts of the Netherlands. Albert Heijn and PLUS report that shelves remain mostly stocked.

item.title: Municipalities struggling with salt shortages; Events canceled amid snow
item.description: Some municipalities are warning that local supplies of road salt are running very low. Heiloo, Bergen, and Leiderdorp are among the places affected.

item.title: Code Orange: Be prepared if you have to take the road, Trains on reduced schedule
item.description: The Netherlands is braced for a lot of snow on Wednesday. The infrastructure agency Rijkswaterstaat has urged people to stay home today.
